Title: The Summoning and No Repeat Actions

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Can you recruit an ally, freak drive, and then play The Summoning
to recruit the same ally again?

The Summoning says "This vampire recruits that ally", but is it
a different action?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
> Can you recruit an ally, freak drive, and then play The Summoning
> to recruit the same ally again?

Yes.

> The Summoning says "This vampire recruits that ally", but is it
> a different action?

It is a different action card, which is all that matters in this
case, since the restriction on playing the same action card is the
only hinderance to recruiting the same ally in the first place.

than once in a turn, no.
